# UNT Web Archive

> A comprehensive digital preservation repository archiving U.S. government websites, congressional records, and federal agency portals for long-term public access.

The UNT Web Archive, also known as the Cyber Cemetery, preserves critical government websites and records that might otherwise be lost. It provides searchable access to archived federal agencies, congressional committees, commissions, and public information portals spanning multiple administrations and policy areas.

- Digital Preservation
- Government Records

## Search & Discovery

- [All Collections Search](https://webarchive.library.unt.edu/allcollections): UNT Web Archive search interface for all collections
- [Data.gov](https://webarchive.library.unt.edu/data): Archived Data.gov federal data discovery portal

## Congressional Oversight & Investigations

- [Select Committee On Benghazi](https://webarchive.library.unt.edu/benghazihouse): Archived House Select Committee on Benghazi records
- [Benghazi Attacks Asked and Answered Database](https://webarchive.library.unt.edu/askedandansweredbenghazi): Searchable FAQ database on Benghazi attacks from House inquiry
- [Select Committee on Benghazi, Democrats](https://webarchive.library.unt.edu/democratsbenghazi): Archived Democratic records from Benghazi Select Committee
- [Select Subcommittee on the Coronavirus Crisis](https://webarchive.library.unt.edu/coronavirus): Archived House Coronavirus Crisis Subcommittee records
- [Congressional Oversight Panel (COP)](https://webarchive.library.unt.edu/cop): Archived Congressional Oversight Panel financial crisis records
- [Congressional Oversight Commission (CARES Act)](https://webarchive.library.unt.edu/coc): Archived Congressional Oversight Commission CARES Act records

## Government Commissions & Task Forces

- [Commission on Evidence-Based Policymaking (CEP)](https://webarchive.library.unt.edu/cep): Archived CEP government commission records
- [Commission to Eliminate Child Abuse and Neglect Fatalities (CECANF)](https://webarchive.library.unt.edu/cecanf): Archived CECANF government commission records
- [The Blue Ribbon Commission on America's Nuclear Future](https://webarchive.library.unt.edu/brc): Archived Blue Ribbon Commission on nuclear policy records
- [Commission on Wartime Contracting (CWC)](https://webarchive.library.unt.edu/cwc): Archived Commission on Wartime Contracting records
- [Joint Select Committee on Deficit Reduction (JSC)](https://webarchive.library.unt.edu/deficit): Archived Joint Select Committee deficit reduction records
- [Charles Colson Task Force on Federal Corrections](https://webarchive.library.unt.edu/colsontaskforce): Archived Charles Colson Task Force federal corrections records

## Federal Agency & Policy Archives

- [U.S. CIO and the Federal CIO Councils](https://webarchive.library.unt.edu/cio): Archived U.S. CIO and Federal CIO Councils records
- [U.S. Climate Change Science Program (CCSP)](https://webarchive.library.unt.edu/climatescience): Archived U.S. Climate Change Science Program records
- [Apps.gov NOW](https://webarchive.library.unt.edu/appsnow): Archived Apps.gov NOW government application portal
- [Official Site of the Deepwater Horizon Unified Command](https://webarchive.library.unt.edu/deepwater): Archived Deepwater Horizon oil spill response records

## Educational & Public Resources

- [Ben's Guide to U.S. Government for Kids](https://webarchive.library.unt.edu/bensguide): Archived Government Publishing Office educational guide

## Optional

- [Commission on the State of U.S. Olympics & Paralympics](https://webarchive.library.unt.edu/csusop): Archived U.S. Olympics & Paralympics Commission records
